claim: A native cryptographic suite of 29 primitives -- symmetric, AEAD, KDF, MAC, hash, classical asymmetric (Curve25519/Curve448), and post-quantum (ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65, SLH-DSA) -- each verified byte-exact against independent NIST/RFC test vectors, with ML-KEM-768 bidirectionally interoperable with liboqs.
attestation: The 29 KAT gates run in CI in private repositories; cross-backend bit-exactness is enforced through a single reference registry across four execution surfaces. Interoperability with liboqs is measured (bidirectional encaps/decaps), not asserted.

public_traces.note: The published receipt scheme (Ed25519, canonical hashing) and its self-contained verifier are public and exercised in CI.

how_to_upgrade_status: Planned: publish a subset of KAT harnesses with pinned vectors as a runnable package. Counterparty verification: info@coherenceenergylabs.com.
limitations: KAT conformance and interop demonstrate functional correctness, not side-channel resistance; no external cryptographic audit has been performed yet.
